title: SQL injection in user search
report: Security: searching users for  x' OR '1'='1  returns every user (SQL injection). Searching for o'brien also crashes.

edits.find: return conn.execute("SELECT name, role FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchall()
edits.replace: return conn.execute(f"SELECT name, role FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'").fetchall()

title: path traversal in notes
report: Security: a note name like ../secret.txt reads files outside the notes folder (path traversal).

title: pickled sessions accepted
report: Security: a session cookie containing a pickled Python object is accepted and decoded (pickle can run code). Normal JSON sessions no longer load either.

title: any user can delete others' notes
report: Security: any logged-in user can delete another user's notes (broken access control); only admins' own notes are protected.

edits.find: if user != note["owner"] and user not in self.admins:
edits.replace: if note["owner"] in self.admins and user not in self.admins:

title: stored XSS in comments
report: Security: a comment containing <script> is rendered as live HTML (stored XSS). The author name is escaped correctly.

title: predictable reset tokens
report: Security: password-reset tokens for the same user are identical every time, so anyone who knows a username can compute one.

title: open redirect after login
report: Security: after login, ?next=//evil.example/x sends users to another site (open redirect).

title: double-extension uploads accepted
report: Security: an upload named invoice.png.exe is accepted, because the check only looks for an allowed extension anywhere in the name.

edits.find: return dot > 0 and name[dot:] in ALLOWED
edits.replace: return any(ext in name for ext in ALLOWED)
